name: wan-a100-serving-optimization
purpose: Small paired serving ablations; generate a plan before reserving GPU time.

optimization.budget_protocol: Pilot selects one seed and the near-load group only. Remaining scenarios and seeds are deferred, never automatically run. Estimates include references, policy replay, idle arrival spans, and 300 seconds per variant for setup; the existing GPU ledger remains authoritative.
optimization.profile_alias_protocol: flash_prefetch may explicitly reuse flash_serial's standalone profile because text prefetch changes online overlap, not isolated request execution. Arrival times and deadlines remain identical across all variants.
